title: MBIC – A Media Bias Annotation Dataset Including Annotator Characteristics
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study or a category within the dataset.

measurement_description: The paper introduces the MBIC dataset, which measures media bias in news sentences. It collects human annotations on whether sentences are biased and which specific words or phrases contribute to the bias. The dataset covers 14 topics, primarily political and social issues in the United States. It does not specifically measure any aspect of faith or religion.
